methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected on 2026-06-14 from each provider's official pricing page where it returned usable content, and from reputable 2026 comparison pages (primarily aura.com/learn) where the official page returned 403/404. LifeLock pricing was fetched from lifelock.norton.com/plans (official, confirmed on two separate fetches). Aura pricing was fetched from aura.com/plans (official). Identity Guard pricing was fetched from identityguard.com/plans (official, confirmed on two separate fetches). IDShield's official idshield.com/plans and idshield.com/individual/ both returned 403, so pricing was taken from aura.com comparison pages (idshield-vs-lifelock and is-idshield-worth-it), which agreed exactly: $14.95/$19.95 individual, $29.95/$34.95 family. IdentityForce's official identityforce.com returned 403; pricing was taken from aura.com/learn/is-identityforce-legit ($19.90/$34.90 individual) and corroborated by aura.com/learn/identityforce-vs-lifelock (identical figures). An older aura.com best-protection roundup showed lower figures ($17.99/$23.99), likely stale; the dedicated review page figures are used. Zander Insurance pricing was fetched from zanderins.com/id-theft/ (official). Experian IdentityWorks Premium price ($24.99/mo) was confirmed on experian.com/consumer-products/identity-theft-protection.html; the Plus plan price could not be extracted from any reachable official or comparison page and is set to null. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer identity theft protection and are null throughout. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony). annualDiscountPct is calculated from published monthly vs annual-billed-monthly figures where both are available.

vendors.name: LifeLock

plans.notes: Month-to-month rate $12.49/mo; annual rate $10.42/mo (billed $124.99/yr). SSN and alert monitoring, $1M stolen funds reimbursement, US-based restoration specialists.

plans.name: Advanced (Individual)

plans.name: Total (Individual)

plans.name: Total (Family – 2 Adults)

plans.name: Advanced (Family – 2 Adults + 10 Kids)

plans.name: Total (Family – 2 Adults + 10 Kids)
plans.notes: Month-to-month rate $74.99/mo; annual rate $62.50/mo (billed $749.99/yr). Covers 2 adults and up to 10 children.

plans.name: Norton 360 with LifeLock Select
plans.notes: All-in-one plan bundling Norton 360 antivirus/VPN with LifeLock identity monitoring. Month-to-month $8.99/mo; annual rate $8.29/mo (billed $99.48/yr). Entry-level bundle.

plans.name: Norton 360 with LifeLock Ultimate Plus
plans.notes: All-in-one plan bundling Norton 360 with LifeLock Ultimate Plus identity protection. Month-to-month $25.99/mo; annual rate $21.67/mo (billed $259.99/yr).

vendors.name: Aura
vendors.provenance: Official aura.com/plans fetched 2026-06-14. Page returned full plan-tier pricing. Corroborated by aura.com/learn/is-aura-worth-it which confirmed annual-billing rates (different promotional figures of $9.99/$17.99/$24.99 appeared there, likely current promotion; official plans page figures used as primary).

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Month-to-month $15/mo; annual rate $12/mo (page states 50% savings — likely reflects introductory offer vs standard annual). Covers 1 adult, up to 10 devices. Includes identity monitoring, $1M identity theft insurance, antivirus, VPN. 14-day free trial; 60-day money-back on annual.

plans.name: Couple
plans.notes: Month-to-month $29/mo; annual rate $22/mo. Covers 2 adults, up to 20 devices. Page states 60% savings on annual — likely includes introductory discount.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Month-to-month $50/mo; annual rate $32/mo. Covers up to 5 adults, unlimited children, unlimited devices. 14-day free trial; 60-day money-back on annual.

plans.name: Kids
plans.notes: Month-to-month $13/mo; annual rate $10/mo. Parental controls and child safety plan for unlimited children, unlimited devices. Does not include adult identity monitoring.

vendors.name: Identity Guard
vendors.provenance: Official identityguard.com/plans fetched 2026-06-14. Page returned full pricing for all six plan tiers. Confirmed on two separate WebFetch calls. Promotional 50%-off annual pricing shown alongside standard annual pricing; standard annual rate used as monthlyUsd with promotional rate noted.

plans.name: Total – Individual
plans.notes: Month-to-month $19.99/mo. Standard annual rate $16.67/mo ($200.04/yr, saves 16%). Promotional annual also at $9.99/mo. Includes three-bureau credit monitoring, bank and 401k monitoring.

plans.name: Ultra – Individual
plans.notes: Month-to-month $29.99/mo. Standard annual rate $25.00/mo ($300/yr, saves 16%). Promotional annual also at $14.99/mo. Adds credit score tracking, social media monitoring, high-risk transaction alerts.

plans.name: Value – Family
plans.notes: Month-to-month $14.99/mo. Standard annual rate $12.50/mo ($150/yr, saves 16%). Promotional annual also at $7.49/mo. Covers 2 adults and dependent children; basic identity monitoring.

plans.name: Total – Family
plans.notes: Month-to-month $29.99/mo. Standard annual rate $25.00/mo ($300/yr, saves 16%). Promotional annual also at $14.99/mo. Covers 2 adults and children with three-bureau credit monitoring.

plans.name: Ultra – Family
plans.notes: Month-to-month $39.99/mo. Standard annual rate $33.33/mo ($399.96/yr, saves 16%). Promotional annual also at $19.99/mo. Full-featured family plan with social media monitoring and high-risk transaction alerts.

vendors.name: IDShield

plans.name: Individual – 1-Bureau

plans.name: Individual – 3-Bureau

plans.name: Family – 1-Bureau
plans.notes: Family plan covering 2 adults and dependent children under 18 with single-bureau credit monitoring. No annual discount rate published in sources reviewed.

plans.name: Family – 3-Bureau
plans.notes: Family plan covering 2 adults and dependent children under 18 with three-bureau credit monitoring. No annual discount rate published in sources reviewed.

vendors.name: IdentityForce
vendors.provenance: Official identityforce.com and identityforce.com/identity-theft-protection-plans both returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. Pricing sourced from two independent aura.com comparison pages: aura.com/learn/is-identityforce-legit and aura.com/learn/identityforce-vs-lifelock, both accessed 2026-06-14. plans.name: UltraSecure – Individual
plans.notes: Identity monitoring without credit monitoring. Annual option available at $199.90/yr (~$16.66/mo). Includes $1M identity theft insurance, social media monitoring, court record monitoring.

plans.name: UltraSecure+Credit – Individual
plans.notes: Adds three-bureau credit monitoring, quarterly three-bureau credit reports, daily TransUnion credit reports and scores. Annual option available at $349.90/yr (~$29.16/mo).

plans.name: UltraSecure – Family
plans.notes: Family plan with identity monitoring, no credit monitoring. Annual option available at $249.90/yr (~$20.83/mo). Covers adults and dependent children.

plans.name: UltraSecure+Credit – Family
plans.notes: Family plan with identity monitoring plus three-bureau credit monitoring. Annual option available at $399.90/yr (~$33.33/mo).

vendors.name: Experian IdentityWorks
vendors.provenance: experian.com/consumer-products/identity-theft-protection.html fetched 2026-06-14 and confirmed Premium plan at $24.99/mo after 7-day free trial. Plus plan pricing was not displayed on any reachable Experian page or comparison page; monthlyUsd set to null. Free tier confirmed as included in Experian's free membership.

plans.name: IdentityWorks Free
plans.notes: Free tier included with Experian free membership. Provides single-bureau (Experian) credit monitoring and basic dark web surveillance. No identity theft insurance or restoration included.

plans.name: IdentityWorks Plus
plans.notes: Mid-tier paid plan; monthlyUsd left null because current pricing is genuinely unconfirmed. Evidence is conflicting as of 2026-06-14: some 2026 reviews (Security.org, SafeHome) report Experian has consolidated to Basic/Premium/Family with no standalone Plus tier, while other reviews still list a Plus tier at $9.99/mo with dark web surveillance and $500K insurance. The official experian.com page surfaces only the Premium plan price, so no Plus figure can be verified from a primary self-serve source.

plans.name: IdentityWorks Premium
plans.notes: Confirmed on official Experian page at $24.99/mo after 7-day free trial. Credit card required to start trial. Includes three-bureau credit monitoring, $1M identity theft insurance, dark web surveillance, social security monitoring.

plans.name: Elite Bundle – Individual

plans.name: Elite Bundle – Family
